name: Learn how to operate AI image generation and editing tools
description: Users sought information on how to install, configure, and operate AI image generation software and traditional editing tools, including requests for prompt engineering techniques, model recommendations, and specific post-processing workflows. The group focused on learning the operational mechanics, availability of free or restricted tools, and troubleshooting specific image editing tasks rather than simply requesting direct image outputs.
